feeds.title: Muscat Daily
feeds.description: Launched on October 10, 2009, Muscat Daily is now the largest-selling broadsheet newspaper in the Sultanate of Oman. Find news on the economy, politics, sports, technology, and more. Muscat Daily provides unrivalled national news coverage from Oman, the region and internationally.

feeds.title: Al Roya
feeds.description: First daily economic newspaper in the Sultanate of Oman. Articles on sports, economics, weather, and more.

feeds.title: Arabian Business » Oman
feeds.description: Comprehensive guide to Oman business & industry news including, banking & finance, construction, energy, media & marketing, real estate, transportation, travel, technology, politics, healthcare, lifestyle & Oman jobs.

feeds.title: Al-Wasl
feeds.description: Al Wisal is the first radio station in Oman. The radio aims to reach a wide range of listeners through its diverse and targeted programming including music, sports, entertainment, health, technology and talk shows.

feeds.title: Times of Oman
feeds.description: Times of Oman is the oldest and the leading English daily newspaper in Oman. It has an overarching goal of providing reliable news along with information and entertainment. The paper consists of a printed daily broadsheet and an online version, which provides its readers with the latest news from Oman, the Middle East, Asia and the world.

feeds.title: Omani Al Watan
feeds.description: Al - Watan is a daily political newspaper that is issued every day of the week without interruption. Find news on politics, society, economy, sport, employment, culture, etc.

feeds.title: Al Shabiba
feeds.description: On the Shabiba website, we provide you with the latest local news of the Sultanate of Oman and everything related to sports news, the economy, technology, and more.

feeds.title: Watan News LLC
feeds.description: A homeland that sings outside the flock. An independent newspaper published in the United States of America since 1991. Comprehensive coverage around the clock of the most important political, technical and social news.
